method.request_latency: Caller writes a prepared JSON line to a persistent worker and reads one complete reply; caller encoding/decoding excluded. Engine order alternates. Five warmups and five repetitions of 30 races per group.
method.worker_service: Separate instrumented release build: after input read through response cleanup. Includes cleanup after the caller can receive the reply; excludes caller input transfer/read and instrumentation report emission.
method.sampling: Request phases measured every race. Tick phases sampled every 32 ticks with rotating request offset. Child timings subtract a calibrated timer cost, then normalize inside enclosing phases. Movement detail from a separate level-2 run is normalized to level-1 movement; estimates are not independently additive.
method.allocation_counts: Separate allocator instrumentation, one pass of 30 races per group after five warmups. Counts allocation and reallocation calls, not peak memory. Internal sampled counts are expanded using each race tick/sample ratio.
method.measurement_selection: Primary paired timings and level-1 profiles are completed non-overlapping runs under background CPU load. The supplemental nine-runner timing also completed before another audit process began. A later overlapping eighteen-runner dense benchmark and overlapping level-1 repeat are excluded.
caveats: Unrelated CPU-heavy jobs ran during the audit. Paired percentage changes are more transferable than absolute timings. Background activity was not interrupted.
Nine- and eighteen-runner groups differ in distance and skills as well as runner count.
Five warmups do not prewarm every course; new course encounters remain in measured requests.
Main workload reuses a 730-definition skill table. Changed tables must be decoded and cloned; a synthetic forced-miss test is included.
Next-stage whole-frame serialization is an isolated prototype with fixture/benchmark parity only, not full-corpus acceptance.

paired.scope: Sequential persistent workers; alternating engine order; 30 races per field-size group, five warmups and five repetitions. Input serialization and caller output decoding excluded.

implementation_stage_comparison.scope: Sequential persistent workers; alternating engine order; 30 races per field-size group, five warmups and five repetitions. Input serialization and caller output decoding excluded.

forced_cache_miss.scope: Synthetic nine-runner standard workload: ignored skill-definition metadata differs each request, forcing a skill-table cache miss; same 30 races, five warmups and five repetitions.
